blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A total of 166,365 police and other government personnel, and civilian volunteers were deployed nationwide on Sunday for security and assistance as crowds flocked to cemeteries and memorial parks for All Saints’ Day. In a statement on Sunday, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said the deployment consists of 78,952 police personnel, 20,837 personnel from other government agencies and units, and 67,524 force multipliers. Of the total deployment, 29,185 personnel are stationed at cemeteries and columbaria, with 5,308 police assistance desks established to extend public assistance. Other personnel are assigned to churches, major roads, transport terminals, tourist destinations, and checkpoints. READ: […]...
